purpose: Equal native stage diagnostics; not performance acceptance.
limitations: Instrumentation changes timing and cannot establish acceptance or causality.
All source/control processes and observations retained. Warmups and smoke excluded only from measured summaries.
No stage quantiles are summed; actual total-query tail vectors retained.
Preparation provenance describes its pre-build state; completed build/run metadata records subsequent formatting and execution.
Successful smoke and scheduled queries validate reconciliation; arbitrary error/panic paths were not separately exercised.
